patches.summary: ListIDs and ResolveByName validate interpolated SQL identifiers against a safe-identifier pattern before use.
patches.reason: ListIDs interpolated a user-supplied resource type (--resources flag) directly into 'SELECT id FROM <table>', and ResolveByName interpolated field names into a json_extract path — both reachable SQL-injection paths against the local SQLite DB. Generator template bug present in every printed CLI's internal/store/store.go.

patches.summary: cacheKey iterates request params in sorted key order so the cache key is stable across invocations.
patches.reason: Unsorted map iteration produced a different cache key each run, defeating the file-based response cache for any multi-parameter request. Generator template bug present in every printed CLI's internal/client/client.go.
